title: 第十七章 幽夜第十八章 小南的心
lines: 屋外阴雨绵绵，自来也倚坐在桌子旁，心中闪过一丝不安，天气骤变，已然黄昏，夜天云四人理应回归，但如今却人影不见。
“自来也老师，天云他们，他们，快去。。”小南突然冲进屋中，气喘吁吁，断断续续的说道，自来也一惊，随即明会剩余三人正身处危局之中，拉着小南便狂奔而走。
山脚小径中，弥彦被困，无力挣扎，看着被巨岩掩埋的夜天云，不知如何是好。而长门，仍旧瘫倒在地，只得眼睁睁看着好友粉身碎骨。
“红发小鬼，跟我走吧。”佐佐木说道，他也不想在浪费时间，免得夜长梦多。
“长门。。”弥彦担忧的喊道，但觉醒血迹的后遗症岂能随心而消，第一次觉醒是当父母被杀时，那次尚且昏厥过去，此次长门未失去意识，已是万幸。
佐佐木看见长门仍不回应，便猜到恐是因觉醒血迹的后遗症，心中大喜，走上前去，准备用强将长门带走。
可是，刚走出几步，佐佐木忽觉后方出现一股危机感，让其全身打了个冷颤，急忙向前一跃，接着后心一凉，却是忍者服已被划破，露出了大片的肌肤。
“天云！”弥彦大叫一声，道出攻击者的身份，语气既惊又喜。
“怎么可能？”佐佐木回过身来，看着持刀而立的夜天云，扫了一眼已崩塌了的石堆，心中骇然无比。
他在夜天云身上感受到了一丝诡异的气息，对方的气势并没有提升，实力并没有突破的迹象，但却给人一丝危险感觉。
夜天云面色如寒月之光泄地，清冷无比，嘴唇上翘，泛起若有若无的笑容，肃杀之中带有浓浓的自信。
佐佐木心中的压力越发强盛，为保万全，佐佐木后跃十数米，手指舞动，欲将两者之间的战斗引入忍术对决。
只是，下一刻，佐佐木眼瞳紧缩，诧异之下瞳孔已如针孔般大小，翻飞的手指已然停下，满脸的骇然和惊疑。
夜天云的身影陡然消失在原地，无声亦无息。
佐佐木环顾四周，空中，脚下，皆仔细观察了不下数遍，却仍旧无法发现夜天云的身影，对方仿佛幽灵一般悄然消失。
佐佐木虽表面未露出太多的惶恐不安，但逐渐沉重的呼吸、轻微颤动的手指，反应出他内心已经涌动如潮。
突然，利刃入肉的疼痛从后背传来，佐佐木不及细想，靠着本能反应向右一偏，已嵌入身体半分的刀锋错了出去，夜天云的身影从背后向前滑过，墨色的刀刃残留着绚丽的血红。
但，因惯性前冲的夜天云还未停下，身影又消失在了茫茫的夜色中，似乎从未存在过。
佐佐木捂着左肋，冷汗已顺着背脊流下，伤口深可见骨，依稀可见森白的肋条，鲜红的血液从指缝中溢出，那温热黏稠的触感提醒着佐佐木之前的攻击不是幻境，而是现实。
长门和弥彦已被诡异的情状震的呆滞，一语不发，周围顿时寂静万分。只是这寂静甚是可怖，这种深处危局却无法探知对手的位置、无法预料对方的攻击、唯有凭感觉躲避攻击的处境让佐佐木几近疯狂。
身经大小数十战的上忍，他还从未如此无计可施。
吐出一口浊气，佐佐木释放出大量查克拉，身体隐隐被一层淡青色的光芒笼罩，双手再度结印，佐佐木拼劲全力，手指连番交错，汗珠顺着手掌边缘淌下，可见佐佐木此时的心境是如此紧张。
“土遁。石柱群刺。”一声高喝，接着便是隆隆巨响，地面刺出条条尖锐的石柱，石刺矮的两三米、高可及五六米，以佐佐木为中心，一条条石刺呈散状向四周延伸，覆盖了周身近五十米的区域。
密密麻麻的石刺让整个地面宛若一片石林，又似石刺构成的钉板，即便是只兔子，也难以立足。
“土遁。碎岩爆！”佐佐木半蹲在地，却双手不停，又是连续结印，且均是高级土遁术，整个石柱林突然颤动起来，细小的碎石在地面滚动。
“嘣”的一声巨响，惊起林中飞鸟，石柱林竟然爆炸开来，烟尘四起，上百条锋锐的石刺已化碎石，地面已被乱石覆盖，若是有人在其中，必会粉身碎骨。
看着地貌几已被改变，长门和弥彦喉头涌动，却已不知是第几次惊诧。
只是，夜天云的身影依旧未现。
蓦地，深夜之中寒光一闪，佐佐木大惊失色，瞳孔中映出的是泛着冷冽寒光的墨色刀锋。
经历过战争的上忍的反射神经确不一般，又是堪堪避开了夜天云的攻击，只是颈部迸出浓郁的血雾，若在深入半公分，佐佐木的颈部动脉便会被切断。
一击之后，夜天云的身影又从佐佐木身旁侧了过去。
“土遁。土龙弹。”佐佐木趁着夜天云身形未消，使出了全身劲力、用了最快的速度，残影纷飞，土龙腾空而起，狰狞的龙首仿佛发出令人心悸的吼叫，似在发泄施术者的怒火，焦虑，还有恐慌。
佐佐木大喝一声，将全身的查克拉注入到了忍术中，土龙粗长了几分后，去势更加迅捷，伴随的强大的风压，一秒的时间便腾飞了近十米，虬首已经逼近了夜天云的后背，佐佐木眼中闪过一丝快意，仿佛已经预见了夜天云惨叫倒地、被土龙碾杀的情景。
随着一声巨大的闷响，土龙撞在地上，所触的地面已被撞出了一个直径十数米的深坑，土龙碎成一块块泥石，堆落在坑底。
content_en:
It was raining outside the house, and Jiraiya was sitting at the table, feeling uneasy in his heart. The weather suddenly changed, and it was already dusk. Ye Tianyun and the four of them should have returned, but now they were nowhere to be seen.
"Jiraiya-sensei, Tianyun and the others, they, go quickly..." Konan suddenly rushed into the room, panting, and said intermittently. Jiraiya was startled, and then Minghui knew that the remaining three people were in a critical situation, so he pulled Konan and ran away.
In the path at the foot of the mountain, Yahiko was trapped and unable to struggle. He looked at the night clouds buried by the huge rocks and didn't know what to do. As for Nagato, he still collapsed on the ground and could only watch his friend being shattered into pieces.
"Red-haired kid, come with me." Sasaki said, he didn't want to waste time, lest he have a long night and dream.
"Nagato..." Yahiko shouted worriedly, but the aftereffects of awakening to blood stains could not disappear easily. The first awakening was when his parents were killed, and he fainted that time. It was lucky that Nagato did not lose consciousness this time.
When Sasaki saw that Nagato still didn't respond, he guessed that it was probably the sequelae of awakening blood stains. He was overjoyed and stepped forward, preparing to take Nagato away by force.
However, just after taking a few steps, Sasaki suddenly felt a sense of crisis behind him, which made him shiver all over. He hurriedly jumped forward, and then felt a chill in his heart, but his ninja suit had been torn, exposing a large area of ​​skin.
"Tianyun!" Yahiko shouted, revealing the identity of the attacker with a tone of surprise and joy.
"How is that possible?" Sasaki turned around, looked at Ye Tianyun standing with a knife, and glanced at the collapsed pile of rocks, feeling extremely horrified.
He felt a strange aura from Ye Tianyun. The opponent's momentum had not improved, and there was no sign of breakthrough in strength, but it gave people a sense of danger.
Ye Tianyun's face was as cold as the light of the cold moon, and his lips were upturned with a faint smile, filled with deep self-confidence in his solemnity.
The pressure in Sasaki's heart became stronger and stronger. To protect himself, Sasaki jumped back ten meters and danced with his fingers, hoping to lead the battle between the two into a ninjutsu duel.
However, the next moment, Sasaki's eyes tightened. In surprise, his pupils were as big as pinholes. His flailing fingers stopped, and his face was full of shock and surprise.
Ye Tianyun's figure suddenly disappeared on the spot, making no sound or breath.
Sasaki looked around, carefully observing the air and feet several times, but still could not find Ye Tianyun's figure, who quietly disappeared like a ghost.
Although Sasaki didn't show much fear on the surface, his gradually heavier breathing and slightly trembling fingers reflected that he was already surging inside.
Suddenly, the pain of a sharp blade piercing his flesh came from his back. Sasaki didn't have time to think about it, and relied on his instinctive reaction to swerve to the right. The blade that was half embedded in his body missed and came out. Ye Tianyun's figure slid forward from behind, and the ink-colored blade was left with brilliant blood red.
However, Ye Tianyun, who was rushing forward with inertia, had not yet stopped, and the figure disappeared into the vast night, as if it had never existed.
Sasaki covered his left rib, cold sweat flowing down his back. The wound was deep enough to see the bone, and the white ribs were vaguely visible. The bright red blood overflowed from the fingers. The warm and sticky touch reminded Sasaki that the previous attack was not an illusion, but reality.
Nagato and Yahiko were stunned by the strange situation and remained silent. The surroundings were suddenly extremely silent. It's just that the silence is very scary. In this deep crisis, being unable to detect the opponent's position, unable to predict the opponent's attack, and having to avoid attacks by feeling makes Sasaki almost crazy.
As a Jonin who had experienced dozens of battles, he had never been so helpless.
Exhaling a breath of turbid air, Sasaki released a large amount of chakra, his body was faintly enveloped by a layer of light cyan light, and his hands formed seals again. Sasaki tried his best, interlacing his fingers repeatedly, and beads of sweat dripped down the edges of his palms. It can be seen that Sasaki was in such a nervous state at this time.
"Earth Escape. Stone pillars with thorns." A loud shout was heard, followed by a loud rumbling sound, and sharp stone pillars pierced out of the ground. The stone thorns were as short as two or three meters and as high as five or six meters. With Sasaki as the center, the stone thorns spread out in scattered directions, covering an area of ​​nearly fifty meters around the body.
The densely packed stone thorns make the entire ground look like a stone forest, and it also looks like a nail board made of stone thorns. Even a rabbit can't stand on it.
"Earth Release. Rock Breaking Explosion!" Sasaki squatted on the ground, but kept making continuous seals with his hands, all of which were advanced Earth Release Techniques. The entire stone pillar forest suddenly trembled, and small gravels rolled on the ground.
A loud "boom" sound startled the birds in the forest. The stone pillar forest exploded, sending smoke and dust everywhere. Hundreds of sharp stone thorns turned into rubble. The ground was covered with rocks. If anyone was among them, they would be shattered to pieces.
Seeing that the landscape had almost been changed, Nagato and Yahiko's throats surged, but they didn't know how many times they were surprised.
However, Ye Tianyun's figure still did not appear.
Suddenly, there was a flash of cold light in the middle of the night, and Sasaki was shocked, and what was reflected in his pupils was an ink-colored blade with a cold light.
The reflex nerves of the Jonin who had experienced the war were indeed extraordinary, and he could barely avoid Ye Tianyun's attack. However, a thick mist of blood burst out from his neck. If it had penetrated half a centimeter, Sasaki's carotid artery would have been severed.
After one blow, Ye Tianyun's figure turned sideways from Sasaki again.
"Earth Escape. Earth Dragon Bullet." Sasaki took advantage of Ye Tianyun's figure to use all his strength and the fastest speed. The afterimages flew into the air, and the earth dragon rose into the sky. The ferocious dragon head seemed to let out a heart-stopping roar, seeming to vent the anger, anxiety, and panic of the caster.
Sasaki shouted loudly and poured all his chakra into the ninjutsu. After the earth dragon grew a few minutes thicker, it moved even faster. With the strong wind pressure, it soared nearly ten meters in one second, and its head was already approaching Ye Tianyun's back.
